name: Estelle Ceulemans - Annexe, recommandation 5, point 1 - Am 8
title: REPORT with recommendations to the Commission on psychosocial risk, stress and mental health at work
part_text: 1. Employers should carry out psychosocial risk assessments where the nature of the activities or working conditions indicates the existence of significant psychosocial risks, taking into account the size, sector and specific circumstances of the undertaking and in accordance with national law and practice.
